Excalidraw Editor | Blog | Documentation | Excalidraw+

An open source virtual hand-drawn style whiteboard.
Collaborative and end-to-end encrypted.


## Features The Excalidraw editor (npm package) supports: - 💯 Free & open-source. - 🎨 Infinite, canvas-based whiteboard. - ✍️ Hand-drawn like style. - 🌓 Dark mode. - 🏗️ Customizable. - 📷 Image support. - 😀 Shape libraries support. - 🌐 Localization (i18n) support. - 🖼️ Export to PNG, SVG & clipboard. - 💾 Open format - export drawings as an `.excalidraw` json file. - ⚒️ Wide range of tools - rectangle, circle, diamond, arrow, line, free-draw, eraser... - ➡️ Arrow-binding & labeled arrows. - 🔙 Undo / Redo. - 🔍 Zoom and panning support. ## Architecture The layers in excalidraw-monorepo work together to provide a robust development environment. The top-level layer manages linting and tests, ensuring code quality. The Docs layer handles the project's documentation, including configuration for Babel and Docusaurus. The With Nextjs layer configures Next.js for the project, while the With Script in Browser layer provides example files for a web application using React and Excalidraw. The Excalidraw App layer contains the main application files, including the main entry point, custom stats, iframe export, Jotai store, constants, bug issue template, collaboration debug, and Sentry configuration. The Documents layer further breaks down into components, data, and tests. The Packages layer holds the project's 7 packages: Excalidraw Common, Excalidraw Element, Excalidraw, Excalidraw Fractional Indexing, Excalidraw Laser Pointer, Excalidraw Math, and Excalidraw Utilities. The Public layer manages the service worker for the public directory, and the Scripts layer contains scripts used for building, packaging, and releasing the software project. | Part | Description | contains scripts used for building, packaging, and releasing the software project. | | ## Excalidraw.com The app hosted at [excalidraw.com](https://excalidraw.com) is a minimal showcase of what you can build with Excalidraw. Its [source code](https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/tree/master/excalidraw-app) is part of this repository as well, and the app features: - 📡 PWA support (works offline). - 🤼 Real-time collaboration. - 🔒 End-to-end encryption. - 💾 Local-first support (autosaves to the browser). - 🔗 Shareable links (export to a readonly link you can share with others). We'll be adding these features as drop-in plugins for the npm package in the future. ## Quick start **Note:** following instructions are for installing the Excalidraw [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@excalidraw/excalidraw) when integrating Excalidraw into your own app. To run the repository locally for development, please refer to our [Development Guide](https://docs.excalidraw.com/docs/introduction/development). Use `npm` or `yarn` to install the package. ```bash npm install react react-dom @excalidraw/excalidraw # or yarn add react react-dom @excalidraw/excalidraw ``` Check out our See the [translation guide](https://docs.excalidraw.com/docs/introduction/contributing#translating). ## Integrations - [VScode extension](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=pomdtr.excalidraw-editor) - [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@excalidraw/excalidraw) ## Who's integrating Excalidraw [Google Cloud](https://googlecloudcheatsheet.withgoogle.com/architecture) • [Meta](https://meta.com/) • [CodeSandbox](https://codesandbox.io/) • [Obsidian Excalidraw](https://github.com/zsviczian/obsidian-excalidraw-plugin) • [Replit](https://replit.com/) • [Slite](https://slite.com/) • [Notion](https://notion.so/) • [HackerRank](https://www.hackerrank.com/) • and many others ## Sponsors & support If you like the project, you can become a sponsor at [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw) or use [Excalidraw+](https://plus.excalidraw.com/). ## Thank you for supporting Excalidraw [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/0/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/1/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/2/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/3/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/4/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/5/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/6/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/7/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/8/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/9/website) [](https://opencollective.com/excalidraw/tiers/sponsors/10/website) Last but not least, we're thankful to these companies for offering their services for free: [![Vercel](./.github/assets/vercel.svg)](https://vercel.com) [![Sentry](./.github/assets/sentry.svg)](https://sentry.io) [![Crowdin](./.github/assets/crowdin.svg)](https://crowdin.com)
